title: player.login
description: A player signed in with their password (C01 §7). Published by the identity module on NATS subject evt.player.login (version 1). Consumers: C12 (session timer, device and velocity checks), C13 (activity report), C14 (NEW_DEVICE_LOGIN SMS when new_device, B13). Registration publishes player.registered instead. Ids only, no personal data. This is the `data` payload; the envelope is TD-02 §5. New fields are additive only.

new_device.description: First sign-in from this device for this player
